CodeDuplicated.zhs: 部门编码在所属公司内必须唯一。
CodeDuplicated.en: Department codes must be unique within the company.

NameDuplicated.zhs: 同一上级下的部门名称必须唯一。
NameDuplicated.en: Department names must be unique under the same parent.

SortOrderInvalid.zhs: 排序码必须为 1 至 32 位 ASCII 数字。
SortOrderInvalid.en: The sort order code must contain 1 to 32 ASCII digits.

CompanyDisabled.zhs: 所属公司已停用，不能创建或调整部门归属。
CompanyDisabled.en: The company is disabled. A department cannot be created or moved into it.

ParentNotFound.en: The parent department does not exist.

ParentCompanyMismatch.zhs: 上级部门必须属于同一公司。
ParentCompanyMismatch.en: The parent department must belong to the same company.

ParentDisabled.zhs: 上级部门已停用，不能作为新的上级。
ParentDisabled.en: The parent department is disabled and cannot be selected as a new parent.

ParentChainDisabled.zhs: 上级部门或其上级链已停用，不能作为新的上级。
ParentChainDisabled.en: The parent department or one of its ancestors is disabled and cannot be selected as a new parent.

ParentSelfReference.zhs: 部门不能把自身设为上级。
ParentSelfReference.en: A department cannot be its own parent.

ParentCycle.zhs: 上级部门不能是当前部门的后代。
ParentCycle.en: The parent department cannot be a descendant of this department.

HierarchyCorrupted.zhs: 现有部门层级包含环或断链，不能调整上级。
HierarchyCorrupted.en: The department hierarchy contains a cycle or broken link. Its parent cannot be changed.

DeleteBlockedByPerson.zhs: 该部门仍被人员引用，不能删除。
DeleteBlockedByPerson.en: This department is referenced by a person and cannot be deleted.

DeleteBlockedByChild.zhs: 该部门仍有子部门，不能删除。
DeleteBlockedByChild.en: This department has child departments and cannot be deleted.

DeleteBlockedByReference.zhs: 该部门仍被引用，不能删除。
DeleteBlockedByReference.en: This department is still referenced and cannot be deleted.
